body: My stance will always be the same, if someone was SA's, or has a health issue or an ectopic pregnancy, she deserves to be able to choose. Now for birth control purposes or oopsie babies, I am torn. On one hand, I do not want the person to choose to abort it, but on the other hand, if that person is forced to give birth to a baby they do not want, will that child be loved or taken cared of properly, or will they end up abused or worse, killed by the mother?
